title: 预约提醒
Booking notifications
help: 注册或预约中填写的邮箱、手机会自动用于预约提醒和本次沟通，可随时关闭。
The email and phone number you provide are used automatically for booking updates and related replies. You can turn either off.
wechat_help: 可订阅预约成功、取消和到店前提醒，每种通知每次授权可接收一条。
Subscribe to confirmation, cancellation and pre-visit notices. Each approval allows one notice per type.
wechat_ready: 本次预约成功提醒已允许
wechat_declined: 未开启预约成功微信提醒，仍可在我的预约中查看状态。
WeChat confirmation alerts were not enabled. You can still check My bookings.
wechat_preparing: 正在准备本次微信提醒…
Preparing WeChat alerts for this booking…
wechat_booking_request: 确认后，可选择接收本次预约的微信提醒。
After confirming, you can choose WeChat alerts for this booking.
wechat_confirm_again: 提醒已重新准备好，请再点一次确认提交。
Alerts are ready again. Tap Confirm to submit.
wechat_tap_again: 提醒已准备好，请再次点击接收微信预约提醒。
Alerts are ready. Tap Receive WeChat booking notifications again.
wechat_submit_without: 仅提交预约，不接收本次微信提醒
wechat_unavailable: 微信提醒暂不可用，其他接收方式不受影响。
WeChat notifications are temporarily unavailable. Other channels are unaffected.
reply_body: 店主发来新消息，查看并回复：{url}
You have a new message from the host. Read and reply: {url}

A customer sent a new message. Read and reply in your workspace: {url}
empty: 有问题可以在这里联系店主。
Send the host a message here.

查看预约或联系店主：{url}

如需重新预约或联系店主：{url}
contact_by_sms: If your plans change or you need to contact the host, reply to this message.
If your plans change or you need to contact the host, reply to this message.
contact_by_email: If your plans change or you need to contact the host, email staywithcsq@outlook.com.
If your plans change or you need to contact the host, email staywithcsq@outlook.com.

If your plans change or you need to contact the host, use your booking page.
card_confirmed: 共{guests}人，请按约定时间到店
card_cancelled: 预约已取消，可重新选择时间
card_reminder: 预约即将开始，点击查看
notification_contact_invalid: 请填写有效的邮箱或 +1 手机号码。
Enter a valid email address or +1 phone number.
notification_preferences_changed: 提醒设置已被修改，请刷新后重试。
Notification settings changed. Refresh and try again.

Could not enable WeChat notifications. Please retry.
notification_wechat_expired: 授权页面已过期，请刷新后再允许提醒。
This authorization page expired. Refresh before subscribing.
message_request_changed: 消息内容已变化，请刷新后再发送。

message_rate_limited: 发送较频繁，请稍等片刻。

generic_error: 暂时未能完成，请稍后重试。

prompt_body: 允许后，我们会通过微信发送预约成功、取消和到店前提醒，方便你及时查看预约状态。
Allow WeChat notifications for booking confirmations, cancellations and reminders before your visit.
